title: Ballsh oil workers’ protests and hunger strike over unpaid wages and refinery reopening
notes: November evidence describes suspension/ending of the hunger strike and a 9 November meeting, not a demonstrated new public gathering of at least 50. S012 is search-only and retrospectively dates protests to 14 September with a 17 September ministry rally; S013 is search-only on a 10 October roadblock; parent reports a distinct 12 October march/roadblock in the October unit. S011 is search-only on a 8 November pause; S016 is an opened government statement on the 9 November meeting after workers ended the strike, with proposals but no completed agreement. Campaign versus discrete gathering/phase boundaries and which unit owns the first qualifying >=50 action remain unresolved; do not merge automatically.
